note: Started as a consumer 'watch party' site (hyperbeam.com) built by three University of Waterloo students; grew to 150k MAU / 1M+ video hours/month per their own YC launch post, then pivoted in 2022 (YC W22 batch) to sell the underlying multiplayer-browser tech as a developer API — the product this card's pricing/features describe. Funding appears to be a small ~$500K seed (YC + a university endowment fund) with no confirmed larger priced round found in press; revenue figures are third-party estimates only, not company-confirmed.
